movie_title: Do you like garlic? ⏲️ 6 Minute English
introduction: It makes our food tasty and our breath smelly, but what are some of the other uses of garlic...? Apa

vocabulary.definition: having many different purposes or uses
vocabulary.example: Garlic is a versatile ingredient that can be used in various dishes.

vocabulary.definition: difficult to imagine because it would be so good or so bad
vocabulary.example: Jason finds cooking without garlic unimaginable.
Garlic was used to treat respiratory ailments in ancient times.

vocabulary.definition: a food or drink believed to increase sexual desire
vocabulary.example: In Ancient Greece, garlic was considered an aphrodisiac.
Jains abstain from eating garlic due to spiritual beliefs.

vocabulary.definition: encourage something or cause it to grow
vocabulary.example: Some cultures believe that garlic stimulates desire.
